clips.title: The story
paras: Blisters on The Land is an Alliance quest offered by Rethiel the Greenwarden along the eastern ridges of the Wetlands. Sensing an unnatural sickness stirring the swamp, the lone bog beast warden tasks travelers with culling the diseased Fen Creepers that stalk the waterways. Putting these shambling plant horrors to rest is Rethiel's attempt to break the swamp's rising fever.

From its grove amid the marshes, Rethiel the Greenwarden watches over the soggy expanse of the Wetlands. The marshes have never been gentle, but recently an unnatural sickness has begun to spread through the mire. Rethiel perceives this affliction as a growing fever in the earth itself, one that causes wild nature to warp into mindless, shambling monstrosities.

The primary symptom of this rot is the rise of Fen Creepers—decaying elemental masses of swamp vegetation that shamble along the waterways. Rethiel describes them as diseased blisters swelling upon the surface of the land. Because their tormented existence only spreads agitation through the marsh, the Greenwarden charges passing allies with destroying them so their tangled remnants can settle harmlessly back into the mud.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I do not know why, but a festering grows within the Wetlands. Fen Creepers have risen. They are diseased, fevered blisters on the land, and for the fever to break they must be dispatched and allowed to settle back into the marshes.
The Fen Creepers shamble amidst the waterways of the Wetlands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Wetlands still weep, and the Fen Creepers still rage. Return to me when your task is done.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This land is soothed by your efforts, and for this I will grant you a boon.
